name: Inflatable May
flavour: Twice the May. Half of her is vinyl.
text: Every 30 s she throws an inflatable May. Where it lands, the creatures around it go for the doll instead of her for 2 s, then it pops. Bosses are not fooled.
art_prompt: an inflatable pink vinyl balloon doll of a mime woman in a beret, arms stiffly out like a scarecrow, a little squashed, shiny seams and a valve nozzle
